source: T. Nan, Y. Hui, M. Rinaldi, N. X. Sun, Self-Biased 215MHz Magnetoelectric NEMS Resonator for Ultra-Sensitive DC Magnetic Field Detection, Sci. Rep. 3, 1985 (2013)
note: Q values quoted verbatim from the text: 'the Q started from 735 (0 Oe) then reached the minimum value of 250 at the transition magnetic field (15 Oe) and finally saturated to 1400 at high magnetic fields (> 60 Oe)'. The frequency swing is NOT stated in the text and exists only in Fig. 2(d), so two readings of that figure are carried: 0.74% (zero field to the dip) and 1.10% (saturation to the dip). Raster figure at about 220 dpi, so the reading is coarse; both values are propagated rather than one being chosen.
independence_note: Different wafer, different fabrication run (2013), different magnetic stack: a FeGaB/Al2O3 multilayer rather than a single FeGaB layer. Same laboratory as [1] (Sun, Northeastern), different device generation.
